questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Man tilmelder sig fag på deres hjemmeside og det er forholdsvist ligetil. Der er dog rigtig stor forske på fagene, så jeg anbefaler at sætte sig godt ind i hvilke fag man tilmelder sig. Det er der god mulighed for at orientere sig i, da man har mulighed for at prøve fagene af og høre mere om eksamen inden den endelige tilmelding.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Der er forskel på udbuddet når man orienterer sig inden man tager afsted og de egentlig udbudte fag.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan spørge den akademiske rådgiver.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg oplevede at et enkelt fag ikke blev eftergodkendt pga. behandlingstid fra studienævnet. Men alt i alt er det fint muligt hvis man sørger for at søge forhåndsgodkendelse i god tid at få det til at gå op.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er meget større forskel på hvad der forventes i de forskellige fag, så sørg for at læse op på eksamensbeskrivelser ved tilmelding af fag.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Min oplevelse er at det faglige niveau er en del anderledes end KU. Der er betydeligt mindre forberedelsestid. Anbefaler at tage fag på fransk, hvis man overvejer det.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der er en tilgang baseret på fremlæggelser og åben diskussion.

questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Der er god mulighed for at møde en masse, særligt når man møder op til de første erasmusarrangementer.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes der er mange muligheder for at møde folk hvis man deltager i arrangementer og hobbyer i byen.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Der er usædvanligt mange forskellige sprog, hvilket er ret spændende, og mange forskellige erfaringer fra forskellige lande, der er super interessante når man diskuterer på studiet og i det hele taget interessant.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær i god tid med at søge bolig, orienter eksamenstypen på de fag du tilmelder dig, så du har tid til at deltage i de mange fede arrangementer og tilbud i byen.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det har været skønt at møde så mange forskellige mennesker og at få mulighed for at tale fransk til hverdag.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det er super svært at vende sig til at tale så meget fransk i de første par uger, men det bliver sjovere henad semesteret.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
